1.text: Balāmu abwira Balaki ati “Nyubakishiriza hano ibicaniro birindwi, unyitegurire hano amapfizi arindwi n'amasekurume y'intama arindwi.”

2.text: Balaki abigenza uko Balāmu amubwiye. Balaki na Balāmu batambira ku gicaniro cyose impfizi n'isekurume y'intama.

3.text: Balāmu abwira Balaki ati “Hagarara iruhande rw'ibitambo byawe byoshejwe nanjye ngende, ahari Uwiteka araza ansanganire; icyo ambwira ndakikubwira.” Ajya mu mpinga y'ibiharabuge.

4.text: Imana isanganira Balāmu arayibwira ati “Niteguye ibicaniro birindwi, ntambira ku gicaniro cyose impfizi n'isekurume y'intama.”

5.text: Uwiteka ashyira ijambo mu kanwa ka Balāmu aramubwira ati “Subira kuri Balaki uvuga utya.”

6.text: Amusubiraho asanga ahagararanye n'abatware b'i Mowabu bose, iruhande rw'ibitambo bye byoshejwe.

7.text: Aca umugani uhanura ati“Mu Aramu ni ho Balaki yankuye,Umwami w'i Mowabu yankuye mu misozi y'iburasirazuba.Ati ‘Ngwino umvumire ubwoko bwa Yakobo,Ngwino urakarire ubwoko bwa Isirayeli.’

8.text: Navuma nte abo Imana itavumye?Kandi narakarira nte abo Imana itarakariye?

9.text: Kuko nitegeye ubwo bwoko ndi hejuru y'ibitare,Nkabwitegera ndi mu mpinga z'imisozi.Dore ni ubwoko butura ukwabwo,Ntibuzabarwa mu mahanga.

10.text: Ni nde ubasha kubara umukungugu w'ubwoko bwa Yakobo?Cyangwa ni nde ubasha kubara igice cya kane cy'Abisirayeli?Icyampa nkipfira nk'uko abakiranutsi bapfa,Iherezo ryanjye rikaba nk'iryabo!”

11.text: Balaki abwira Balāmu ati “Ungenjeje ute? Nakuzaniye kuvuma ababisha banjye, none ubahesheje umugisha musa?”

12.text: Aramusubiza ati “Ibyo Uwiteka ashyize mu kanwa kanjye, sinkwiye kwirinda akaba ari byo mvuga?”

13.text: Balaki aramubwira ati “Ndakwinginze, ngwino nkujyane ahandi aho uri bubashe kubītegera, kuko witēgeye impera imwe yabo gusa ntubitēgere bose, abe ari ho ubamvumirira.”

14.text: Amujyana mu ishyamba ry'i Sofimu amugeza mu mpinga ya Pisiga, yubakaho ibicaniro birindwi, atamba impfizi n'isekurume y'intama ku gicaniro cyose.

15.text: Balāmu abwira Balaki ati “Hagarara hano iruhande rw'ibitambo byawe byoshejwe, mbanze mpurire n'Uwiteka hariya.”

16.text: Uwiteka asanganira Balāmu ashyira ijambo mu kanwa ke, aramubwira ati “Subira kuri Balaki uvuge utya.”

17.text: Asanga ahagararanye n'abatware b'i Mowabu iruhande rw'ibitambo bye. Balaki aramubaza ati “Uwiteka yavuze iki?”

18.text: Aca umugani uhanura ati“Haguruka Balaki wumve,Ntegera ugutwi, mwene Sipori.

19.text: Imana si umuntu ngo ibeshye,Kandi si umwana w'umuntu ngo yicuze.Ibyo yavuze, no gukora ntizabikora?Ibyavuye mu kanwa kayo, no gusohoza ntizabisohoza?

20.text: Dore nategetswe kubahesha umugisha,Na yo yawubahaye simbasha kuwukura.

21.text: Ntibonye gukiranirwa k'ubwoko bwa Yakobo,Ubugoryi ntibubonye ku Bisirayeli,Uwiteka Imana iri kumwe na bo,Ni umwami wabo, bayivugiriza impundu.

22.text: Imana yabakuye muri Egiputa ni yo ibajyana,Ifite amaboko nk'ay'imbogo.

23.text: Nta kuragura kuri mu bwoko bwa Yakobo,Nta bupfumu buri mu Bisirayeli,Mu gihe cyategetswe Abayakobo n'Abisirayeli bazabwirwa icyo Imana ikora.

24.text: Dore ubwo bwoko bubaduka nk'intare y'ingore,Buvumbuka nk'intare y'ingabo.Ntizaryama itararya umuhigo,Itaranywa amaraso y'abishwe.”

25.text: Balaki abwira Balāmu ati “Ntubavume na hato, ntubaheshe umugisha na muke.”

26.text: Maze Balāmu abwira Balaki ati “Sinakubwiye nti ‘Icyo Uwiteka avuga cyose ni cyo nkwiriye gukora’? ”

27.text: Balaki abwira Balāmu ati “Nuko ngwino nkujyane ahandi, ahari Imana irakunda ko ubamvumirirayo.

28.text: Balaki ajyana Balāmu mu mpinga ya Pewori, harengeye ubutayu.”

29.text: Balāmu abwira Balaki ati “Nyubakishiriza hano ibicaniro birindwi, unyitegurire hano amapfizi arindwi n'amasekurume y'intama arindwi.”

30.text: Balaki abigenza uko Balāmu amubwiye, atambira ku gicaniro cyose impfizi n'isekurume y'intama.
